newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends down on API pressure in low volum.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends down on API pressure in low volum.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended slightly lower on Wednesday amid low volumes, brokers said.
The June contract settled $1.50 down at $176.25 a tonne.
"It's being a very quite day," said one broker. "I think we're just being seeing a bit of consolidation."
Brokers attributed initial losses to mildly bearish American Petroleum Institute (API) data released on Tuesday showing U.S. middle distillate stocks rose by 1.9 million barrels last week.
Department of Energy (DOE) data released on Wednesday showed a slightly bigger build of 2.4 million barrels.
IPE July Brent, meanwhile, was 15 cents lower at $19.85 a barrel at 1649 GMT as it tracked NYMEX crude futures' return to negative territory.
"There's nothing very much going on we're just following NYMEX's lead," said another broker.
